The '''''Rho''-class transport shuttle''', shortened as '''''Rho''-class shuttle''' and known also as '''''Ru''-class shuttle''', was a class of [[transport]] [[shuttle]] deployed by the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and later by its successor government, the [[Galactic Empire]] and its [[Imperial Navy]]. A transport variant of the [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class attack/transport shuttle]], the ''Rho''-class served in a cargo transportation role and as a [[Hospital ship|medical transport]]. When operating in the latter role in the [[Republic Navy]], the ''Rho''-class transport shuttle was known as the '''Republic medical shuttle'''.

==Description==
The ''Rho''-class [[transport]] [[shuttle]]<ref name="Rho DB" /> was visually extremely similar to the [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class attack/transport shuttle]],<ref name="Gungan General">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref> with key differences being a dorsal wing, an elongated [[hull]], and the ability to attach and carry cargo pods for passengers, supplies or mobile barracks to the underside of the ventral hull. The shuttle class was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]], [[engine]] units,<ref name="The Unknown" /> six [[laser cannon]]s, and [[magnetic clamp]]s. Flown by two [[pilot]]s,<ref name="Starfighter Encyclopedia" /> the [[starship]]s could carry multiple passengers. Its primary roles were as a [[Hospital ship|medical]]<ref name="The Unknown" /> or general-purpose transport,<ref name="Rho DB" /> and it was also known as a [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] medical shuttle.<ref name="Unknown EG">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-unknown-episode-guide|text="The Unknown" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref> During the Imperial era, they were equipped with cables to drop troopers into battle and/or extract them.

Among the standard [[Color|red]] and yellow markings of both the ''Rho''-class<ref name="MIA" /> and ''Nu''-class shuttles,<ref name="Gungan General" /> those used by the [[Republic Medic Corps]] featured orange and blue markings.<ref name="The Unknown" /> Some ''Rho''-class shuttles, such as one used after the [[Siege of Mandalore]], had light grey and red markings in a pattern similar to the livery of a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Shattered">{{TCW|Shattered}}</ref> [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] ''Rho''-class shuttles were painted a uniform grey.<ref name="Rescue on Ryloth" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
[[File:DSquadCargoShuttle-PoNR.png|thumb|left|235px|A ''Rho''-class transport shuttle used by D-Squad during the Carida incident.]]
The ''Rho''-class transport shuttle was deployed by the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. One [[D-Squad's shuttle|shuttle]] was stationed on [[Abafar]], where it was used by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] forces to transport [[rhydonium]] from a Separatist [[Rhydonium mining installation|mining installation]] to a stolen Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Renown]]''. There, the shuttle was [[Escape from Abafar|retaken]] by the Republic [[special forces]] unit [[D-Squad]], under the command of [[Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon]].<ref name="MIA" /> Once aboard the ''Renown'', the [[squad]] discovered that the ship was under Separatist control while in [[hyperspace]]. As the [[squad]] evaded Separatist [[droid]] forces, the ''Renown'' eventually reached its destination, the Republic [[space station]] [[Valor (space station)|''Valor'']] in the [[Carida system]]. The station was hosting a [[Republic strategy conference|strategy conference]] with the high echelons of the [[Republic Military]]. There, D-Squad managed to escape from the ''Renown'' on the ''Rho''-class shuttle they previously used, and survived the blast when the ''Renown'' [[Carida incident|detonated prematurely]].<ref name="Point of No Return">{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}}</ref>

[[File:MedicalTransportShuttle-TU.png|thumb|right|235px|A ''Rho''-class transport shuttle that carried Tup was ambush.]]
The ''Rho''-class transport shuttle was again deployed during the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda]]. There, [[Unidentified transport shuttle (Ringo Vinda)|one]] was used in its medical capacity to transport [[clone trooper]] [[Tup]], who had suffered a medical episode and [[Death|killed]] [[Jedi General]] [[Tiplar]] in the middle of battle. Despite being escorted by four [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter|ARC-170 starfighters]] and a small contingent of [[Cloning|clone]] [[trooper]]s, Separatist forces were able to ambush the shuttle and kidnap the sedated Tup. Later, [[Jedi]] [[General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]], and [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] [[Fives]] investigated the wreckage and launched a mission to recapture their comrade.<ref name="The Unknown" />

Some [[time]] later, another medical shuttle was deployed in the aftermath of the [[Battle on Ord Mantell|Battle of Ord Mantell]], an engagement between the Separatist Alliance and the [[Shadow Collective]].<ref name="Maul 3">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 3|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 3]]</ref> Another ''Rho''-class shuttle was deployed in the aftermath of the Siege of [[Mandalore]] between the Republic and the Shadow Collective. There, the shuttle transported the Collective's leader, renegade [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]], to the Venator<ref name="Shattered" /> ''[[Tribunal]]''<ref name="TCW CE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]''</ref> under armed guard.<ref name="Shattered" />

===Imperial Era===
Following the [[Proclamation of the New Order|reorganization]] of the Republic into the Galactic Empire at the end of the Clone Wars, the [[Imperial Military]] continued to use the ''Rho''-class transport shuttle. Now with Imperial livery, a group of shuttles were used on the Imperial [[planet]] [[Ryloth]] to transport local [[Twi'lek]] workers to an [[Imperial doonium refinery]]. [[Free Ryloth Movement]] member [[Hera Syndulla]] and the young clone [[Omega]] of the rogue special forces unit [[Clone Force 99]] stole a [[Shuttle two|''Rho''-class shuttle]] from a landing pad and used it to [[Rescue on Ryloth|destroy]] the control systems for the facility's [[turbolaser]] defenses. As a result, the five [[autocannon]]s were disabled and open to attack by Clone Force 99's [[Omicron-class attack shuttle|''Omicron''-class attack shuttle]], the [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']].<ref name="Rescue on Ryloth" />

3 Rho-class shuttles arrived to the [[Imperial Depot (Barton IV)|Imperial Depot]] on [[Barton IV]] with several [[TK stormtrooper|TK stormtroopers]] to help Lieutenant [[Nolan]] transport crates containing [[TK stormtrooper armor|gear]] for their fellow recruits in the [[Stormtrooper Corps]], which was growing due to the passage of the [[Imperial Defense Recruitment Bill]] in the [[Imperial Senate]].<ref name="The Outpost">{{TBB|The Outpost}}</ref>

[[Doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]] used a [[Hemlock's shuttle|Rho shuttle]] to arrive at [[Raven's Peak]] on the planet [[Eriadu]] for an [[Imperial summit on Eriadu|Imperial summit]]. [[Clone Force 99]] tracked Hemlock's shuttle in an attempt to save their brother [[Crosshair]] by placing a [[homing beacon]] on the ship. However their plans came to a halt when Saw Gererra was on a [[Bombing of Raven's Peak|mission of his own]]. When Gerrerra and his team escape they stole a Rho shuttle.<ref name="The Summit" />

[[File:EmperorPalpatinesShuttle-ShadowsOfTantiss.png|thumb|right|235px|Palpatine rode aboard a ''Rho''-class transport shuttle when he visited Tantiss Base.]]
During the early [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] the [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] used [[Emperor Palpatine's shuttle (Rho-class transport shuttle)|one such shuttle]] as his personal craft to [[Tantiss Base]] on the [[planet]]<ref name="KL EG">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/kamino-lost-episode-guide|text="Kamino Lost" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}}</ref> [[Wayland]]. It was heavily guarded including by [[Emperor's Royal Guard]]s and accompanied by four [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]]. Unlike most ''Rho''-class shuttles, it lacked the ventral cargo pod and was [[gray]]-[[color]]ed with red highlights on the wings.<ref name="SOT" />

Unknown to Palpatine, Omega and Crosshair manage to escape by stealing a ''Rho''-class shuttle meant to recapture them.<ref name="SOT" /> Although the shuttle was damaged the pair manage to land it on the planet [[Lau]]. Despite their disguises, [[Captain]] [[Mann]] manage to denounce where they came from, forcing them to steal one of [[Lau cargo ship]]s.<ref name="ADA">{{TBB|A Different Approach}}</ref>

When the [[Clone X trooper]] [[CX-2]] located [[CX-1]] at the [[B'omarr Order Monastery]] on [[Teth]], he planted [[thermal detonator]]s on the [[Clone Underground]]'s ''Rho''-class transport shuttles and had them exploded which killed several of the Underground members. When [[Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe]] lead a [[Recovery Strike Team]] to capture Omega, they arrived in two ''Rho''-class transport shuttles.<ref name="Infiltration" /> One of the shuttles was destroyed by Crosshair when he shot the pilot and engine with his [[773 Firepuncher sniper rifle]]. After Wolffe allowed the Underground members go, he and the strike team left on their last ''Rho''-class shuttle.<ref name="Extraction">{{TBB|Extraction}}</ref>

After breaking out former Imperial [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]], [[Echo]] arrived in a stolen ''Rho''-class shuttle called [[Alpha-44]] to travel to [[Imperial Station 003]] above [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Breach">{{TBB|Into the Breach}}</ref> Although when they arrived at [[Wayland]], several V-wing starfighters shot the shuttle down, but not before the Bad Batch and Rampart manage to escape and hide in the [[forest]] surrounding [[Tantiss Base]].<ref name="Flash Strike">{{TBB|Flash Strike}}</ref> The rescued Clones and Clone Force 99 later used a ''Rho''-class shuttle to escape Tantiss after Hunter and Crosshair killed Scorch and Hemlock to save Omega.<ref name="The Calvary Has Arrived">{{TBB|The Cavalry Has Arrived}}</ref>

A ''Rho''-class shuttle with a compartment of TK stormtroopers was accompanied by two [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] gunships to land on [[Janix]] while investigating the renegade Sith Lord Maul, who survived [[Order 66]] from [[Jesse]] and the [[332nd Company]] by fleeing the ''Tribunal'' after being freed by Tano.<ref name="Teaser Trailer">{{SWYouTube|oonACDq89BY|Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord | Official Teaser Trailer | Streaming April 6 on Disney+}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Rho''-class shuttle first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|season five]] episode "[[Missing in Action]],"<ref name="MIA" /> which premiered on [[January 5]], [[2013]], in the United States.<ref name="Explore: Missing in Action">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/missing-in-action-episode-guide|text="Missing in Action" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref> It was first identified as the ''Rho''-class transport shuttle in its [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry, which was published on [[July 19]], [[2021]].<ref name="Rho DB" />
